title: Keep the viewer's note text as a Tab stop and give it a focus ring
context: Wave 3 pre-launch audit: the log viewer's selectable note text (NoteReaderView's selection focus node) is a Tab stop with no ring, which fails the keyboard rule that every stop shows a ring. Keyboard users use it to select text with Shift and the arrows.
options: Keep the stop and paint the focus ring around the note text from the viewer panel
Take the note text out of Tab order
outcome: Owner chose: keep it and add a ring. The note text stays a Tab stop and shows the focus ring while keyboard-focused, drawn from log_viewer_panel.dart; keyboard text selection keeps working.
